_loader_notes: Recipes (AGENTS.md v2.4 F2 and F3). Draft for review by a Registered Dietitian (HCPC) or Registered Nutritionist (AfN). Fill reviewed_by and reviewed_at before publishing.
nutrition_per_serving is calculated by scripts/nutrition-calc.mjs from CoFID 2021 plus content/food/nutrition-extras.json. Never let an AI estimate it.
Each ingredient has nutrition_lookup and food_id (a CoFID code, or ext-... for extras). Household measures use content/food/ingredient-weights.json.
intended_claims are what the recipe is designed for. verified_claims is filled only when the calculated recipe meets UK high-protein or high-fibre rules.
Allergens are worked out from each ingredient and list the 14 UK major allergens. check_label_notes cover ingredients whose allergens vary by brand. The dietitian should check every recipe.
dietary_tags are calculated: vegetarian (no meat or fish), vegan (no animal products; optional honey ignored), gluten_free (no gluten-containing cereals), dairy_free (no milk).
Servings stepper: scale quantity linearly; round counts sensibly (eggs to whole numbers, spices to the nearest pinch).
Shopping list: group by ingredient aisle; combine the same ingredient_key across recipes.
Food never appears as a reward for training. No calorie counts in titles, collections or filters. Macros only on the recipe page, and hidden when profiles.hide_macros is on.
Covers: every recipe needs its own real, matching, licensed photo (cover_image_slug).
disclaimer: These recipes are general information to help you fuel your training. They aren't personal nutrition or medical advice. Nutrition values are estimates calculated from UK food composition data and will vary with the brands and amounts you use. Always check product labels for allergens. If you have a medical condition or food allergy, are pregnant, or have a history of disordered eating, please speak to your GP or a registered dietitian before changing what you eat.

recipes.title: Berry overnight oats
recipes.summary: Make it the night before and breakfast is waiting for you.
method_steps: Stir the oats, milk, yoghurt and chia seeds together in a jar or bowl.
Top with the berries (straight from frozen is fine).
Cover and chill overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
Drizzle with honey if you like, and eat cold.
check_label_notes: Oats contain gluten unless labelled gluten free.

recipes.title: Peanut butter banana porridge
recipes.summary: Warm, filling and ready in five minutes.
method_steps: Put the oats and milk in a small pan over a medium heat.
Stir for 4 to 5 minutes until thick and creamy. Add a splash of water if it gets too thick.
Pour into a bowl and top with the banana, peanut butter and cinnamon.
check_label_notes: Oats contain gluten unless labelled gluten free.

recipes.title: Spinach and feta omelette
recipes.summary: A quick, savoury breakfast with plenty of protein.
method_steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of black pepper.
Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Wilt the spinach for 30 seconds.
Pour in the eggs and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, gently pulling the edges in as they set.
Scatter over the feta and tomatoes, fold in half and cook for 1 more minute.
Serve with the toast.
check_label_notes: Most UK supermarket feta is vegetarian, but check the label.
Check the label: some breads contain soya, sesame or milk.

recipes.title: Greek yoghurt crunch bowl
recipes.summary: Creamy yoghurt, fruit and a crunchy topping. No cooking needed.
method_steps: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with the berries, seeds and walnuts.
Drizzle with honey if you like.

recipes.title: Smoked salmon and scrambled eggs
recipes.summary: A weekend-feeling breakfast that takes ten minutes.
method_steps: Toast the sourdough.
Beat the eggs. Heat the oil in a small non-stick pan over a low heat.
Add the eggs and stir slowly for 2 to 3 minutes until just set.
Pile onto the toast with the smoked salmon, black pepper and a squeeze of lemon.
check_label_notes: Smoked salmon isn't recommended during pregnancy unless cooked.
Check the label: some breads contain soya, sesame or milk.

recipes.title: Prep-ahead breakfast burritos
recipes.summary: Make four on Sunday, wrap and freeze, then reheat on busy mornings.

ingredients.name: spring onions
ingredients.nutrition_lookup: Spring onions, bulbs and tops, raw

method_steps: Heat the oil in a large non-stick pan and soften the pepper for 3 minutes.
Add the beans, spring onions and paprika and warm through.
Beat the eggs, pour into the pan and stir gently until just set.
Divide between the wraps, sprinkle with cheese, then fold in the sides and roll up.
Eat now, or cool, wrap in foil and chill for up to 3 days or freeze for up to a month. Reheat until piping hot all the way through.
check_label_notes: Most UK Cheddar is vegetarian, but check the label.
Check the label: some wraps contain milk or soya.

recipes.title: Blueberry baked oats
recipes.summary: Like a warm, soft pudding for breakfast. Bake two portions and keep one for tomorrow.
method_steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Lightly grease a small ovenproof dish.
Mix the oats, banana, egg, milk and cinnamon together.
Stir in most of the blueberries, pour into the dish and scatter the rest on top.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden and just set.
Eat warm, or chill and eat within 2 days.
check_label_notes: Oats contain gluten unless labelled gluten free.

recipes.title: Veggie egg muffins
recipes.summary: Twelve grab-and-go egg muffins for breakfasts or snacks.

ingredients.name: spring onions
ingredients.nutrition_lookup: Spring onions, bulbs and tops, raw

method_steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Brush a 12-hole muffin tin with the oil.
Divide the spinach, pepper and spring onion between the holes.
Beat the eggs with the milk and pour over the vegetables. Top with the cheese.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes until set and golden.
Cool, then chill for up to 3 days. Eat cold or reheat until piping hot.
check_label_notes: Most UK Cheddar is vegetarian, but check the label.

recipes.title: Turmeric tofu scramble
recipes.summary: A plant-based twist on scrambled eggs.
method_steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat and cook the garlic for 30 seconds.
Crumble in the tofu with your fingers, add the turmeric and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and spinach and cook until the spinach wilts.
Season with black pepper and serve on the toast.
check_label_notes: Check the label: some breads contain soya, sesame or milk.

recipes.title: Cottage cheese and tomato toast
recipes.summary: A five-minute breakfast with a protein boost.
method_steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with the cottage cheese.
Top with the tomatoes, chilli flakes and black pepper.
check_label_notes: Check the label: some breads contain soya, sesame or milk.

recipes.title: Apple and cinnamon bircher
recipes.summary: Soaked oats with grated apple and cinnamon. Makes two breakfasts.
method_steps: Mix the oats, apple, milk, yoghurt and cinnamon in a bowl.
Cover and chill overnight.
Stir, divide between two bowls and top with the walnuts. Keeps for 2 days in the fridge.
check_label_notes: Oats contain gluten unless labelled gluten free.

recipes.title: Mango chia pudding
recipes.summary: A plant-based breakfast you can make in two minutes the night before.

ingredients.name: unsweetened soya drink
ingredients.nutrition_lookup: Soya, non-dairy alternative to milk, unsweetened

method_steps: Whisk the chia seeds, soya drink and maple syrup together.
Leave for 5 minutes, then whisk again so it doesn't clump.
Cover and chill overnight.
Top with the mango to serve. Keeps for 2 days.

recipes.title: Avocado and eggs on sourdough
recipes.summary: Creamy avocado, soft eggs and a pinch of chilli.
method_steps: Bring a small pan of water to a gentle simmer and poach or boil the eggs (6 to 7 minutes for soft-boiled).
Toast the bread and mash the avocado with the lemon juice.
Spread the avocado on the toast, top with the eggs and a pinch of chilli.
check_label_notes: Check the label: some breads contain soya, sesame or milk.

recipes.title: Smoky homemade beans on toast
recipes.summary: Proper beans in 15 minutes, with a smoky tomato sauce.
method_steps: Heat the oil in a pan and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the paprika, passata and beans. Simmer for 6 to 8 minutes until thick.
Season with black pepper and serve on toast.
check_label_notes: Check the label: some breads contain soya, sesame or milk.

recipes.title: Chicken and quinoa prep bowls
recipes.summary: Four lunches from one tray. Roast, portion and you're set for the week.
method_steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Toss the chicken, pepper and chickpeas with the oil and paprika on a large tray. Roast for 15 minutes.
Add the broccoli to the tray and roast for 10 more minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the quinoa in boiling water for 12 to 15 minutes, then drain.
Slice the chicken, divide everything between four containers and squeeze over the lemon.
Cool quickly and chill for up to 3 days.

recipes.title: Tuna and sweetcorn pasta salad
recipes.summary: A creamy, protein-packed pasta salad that travels well.

ingredients.name: tinned tuna in spring water, drained
ingredients.display: 220g tinned tuna in spring water, drained

method_steps: Cook the pasta following the packet instructions, then rinse under cold water and drain.
Mix the yoghurt and lemon juice with black pepper.
Stir in the pasta, tuna, sweetcorn, onion and cucumber.
Divide into containers and chill for up to 2 days.

recipes.title: Spiced red lentil soup
recipes.summary: A thick, warming soup that's ready in 30 minutes and freezes brilliantly.

ingredients.name: vegetable stock cube
ingredients.display: 1 vegetable stock cube, made up to 1 litre

method_steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and soften the onion and carrot for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils are soft.
Blend until smooth (or leave it chunky) and stir in the lemon juice.
Chill for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 3 months.
check_label_notes: Many stock cubes contain celery; some contain gluten or milk. Check the label.

recipes.title: Smashed chickpea wraps
recipes.summary: A quick plant-based lunch with a lemony tahini filling.
method_steps: Roughly mash the chickpeas with a fork.
Stir in the tahini, lemon juice and black pepper.
Fold through the cucumber and pepper.
Divide between the wraps with the spinach and roll up.
check_label_notes: Check the label: some wraps contain milk or soya.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar-style wraps
recipes.summary: A lighter take on Caesar salad, wrapped up for lunch.

ingredients.name: vegetarian Italian-style hard cheese
ingredients.display: 20g vegetarian Italian-style hard cheese, finely grated

method_steps: Rub the chicken with the oil and cook in a griddle or frying pan for 5 to 6 minutes each side until cooked through. Slice.
Mix the yoghurt, cheese, lemon juice, garlic and mustard to make the dressing.
Toss the leaves in the dressing, then divide between the wraps with the chicken and roll up.
check_label_notes: Choose a vegetarian version; traditional Parmesan is not vegetarian.
Check the label: some wraps contain milk or soya.

recipes.title: Salmon rice bowl
recipes.summary: Soy-glazed salmon with rice, edamame and crunchy veg.

ingredients.name: spring onions
ingredients.nutrition_lookup: Spring onions, bulbs and tops, raw

method_steps: Cook the rice following the packet instructions, adding the edamame for the last 3 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Brush the salmon with 1 tbsp soy sauce and roast for 12 to 15 minutes until cooked through.
Mix the rest of the soy sauce with the sesame oil.
Divide the rice and edamame between bowls. Top with flaked salmon, cucumber, avocado and spring onions, then drizzle with the dressing.
check_label_notes: Use tamari labelled gluten free if you avoid gluten.

recipes.title: Halloumi and herby couscous salad
recipes.summary: Golden halloumi with lemony couscous and chickpeas.
method_steps: Put the couscous in a bowl, pour over 150 ml boiling water, cover and leave for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and stir in the chickpeas, tomatoes, cucumber, mint, lemon juice and oil.
Dry-fry the halloumi in a non-stick pan for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Serve the couscous topped with the halloumi.
check_label_notes: Most halloumi is vegetarian, but check the label.

recipes.title: Prawn, avocado and sweetcorn salad
recipes.summary: A fresh, zingy salad that comes together in ten minutes.
method_steps: Heat a little of the oil in a frying pan and cook the prawns for 3 to 4 minutes until pink all the way through.
Mix the rest of the oil with the lime juice.
Toss the leaves, avocado, tomatoes, cucumber and sweetcorn with the dressing, then top with the prawns.

recipes.title: Turkey and hummus pittas
recipes.summary: A packed-lunch classic with extra crunch.
method_steps: Warm the pittas in a toaster and slice open.
Spread the inside with hummus.
Fill with the turkey, leaves, cucumber and pepper.
check_label_notes: Check the label: some breads contain sesame or milk.
Hummus contains sesame (tahini).

recipes.title: Roasted tomato and white bean soup
recipes.summary: Sweet roasted tomatoes and peppers, blended with beans for a creamy, filling soup.

ingredients.name: vegetable stock cube
ingredients.display: 1 vegetable stock cube, made up to 500 ml

method_steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Roast the tomatoes, peppers, onion and garlic with the oil for 30 minutes.
Tip into a pan with the beans and stock and simmer for 5 minutes.
Blend with the basil until smooth.
Chill for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 3 months.
check_label_notes: Many stock cubes contain celery; some contain gluten or milk. Check the label.

recipes.title: Peanut noodle salad jars
recipes.summary: Three lunches layered in jars, with a peanut and lime dressing.

ingredients.name: spring onions
ingredients.nutrition_lookup: Spring onions, bulbs and tops, raw

method_steps: Cook the noodles and edamame following the packet instructions. Rinse under cold water and drain.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice and 2 tbsp warm water into a dressing.
Divide the dressing between three jars, then layer in the noodles, edamame, carrot, pepper and spring onions.
Chill for up to 3 days. Shake or stir before eating.
check_label_notes: Use tamari labelled gluten free if you avoid gluten.

recipes.title: Chilli bean jacket sweet potatoes
recipes.summary: Soft sweet potatoes with a quick smoky bean chilli.

ingredients.name: spring onions
ingredients.nutrition_lookup: Spring onions, bulbs and tops, raw

method_steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Prick the sweet potatoes and bake for 40 to 45 minutes until soft (or microwave for 8 to 10 minutes).
Meanwhile, simmer the beans, passata, cumin and paprika for 10 minutes.
Split the potatoes, spoon over the beans and top with yoghurt and spring onions.

recipes.title: Lentil, feta and tomato salad
recipes.summary: A hearty salad that's even better the next day.
method_steps: Rinse and drain the lentils.
Mix with the tomatoes, cucumber and onion.
Whisk the oil and vinegar and toss through.
Top with the rocket and feta. Keeps for 2 days without the rocket.
check_label_notes: Most UK supermarket feta is vegetarian, but check the label.

recipes.title: Creamy egg salad sandwiches
recipes.summary: Egg mayo made with yoghurt, with a little mustard kick.

ingredients.name: spring onions
ingredients.nutrition_lookup: Spring onions, bulbs and tops, raw

method_steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Mash with the yoghurt, mustard, spring onions and black pepper.
Fill the bread with the egg mix and salad leaves.
check_label_notes: Check the label: some breads contain soya, sesame or milk.

recipes.title: One-pot lemony chicken orzo
recipes.summary: Everything cooks in one pan, including the pasta.

ingredients.name: chicken stock cube
ingredients.display: 1 chicken stock cube, made up to 750 ml

method_steps: Heat the oil in a large lidded pan and brown the chicken for 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in the orzo and stock. Cover and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the orzo is tender and the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the spinach, lemon zest and juice, and the cheese.
check_label_notes: Many stock cubes contain celery; some contain gluten or milk. Check the label.
Choose a vegetarian version; traditional Parmesan is not vegetarian.

recipes.title: Turkey and bean chilli
recipes.summary: A big batch of mild chilli for dinners and freezer portions.
method_steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and brown the mince for 5 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the onion, pepper and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spices, tomatoes and beans. Simmer for 25 minutes until thick.
Meanwhile, cook the rice following the packet instructions.
Serve the chilli with the rice. Freezes for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Salmon, potato and broccoli traybake
recipes.summary: One tray, minimal washing up and a proper dinner.
method_steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the potatoes with the oil and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the broccoli, tomatoes and garlic, and nestle in the salmon. Squeeze over half the lemon.
Roast for 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon is cooked through.
Serve with the rest of the lemon.

recipes.title: Chickpea and spinach curry
recipes.summary: A mild, creamy coconut curry that's plant-based and very filling.
method_steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and tomatoes, add the chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the rice following the packet instructions.
Stir the spinach into the curry until wilted and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Beef and broccoli noodles
recipes.summary: A quick stir-fry that's faster than a takeaway.
method_steps: Cook the noodles following the packet instructions, then drain.
Heat the olive oil in a wok over a high heat and stir-fry the beef for 2 minutes. Lift out.
Add the broccoli, pepper, garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 3 minutes with a splash of water.
Return the beef, add the noodles, soy sauce and sesame oil and toss until hot.
check_label_notes: Use tamari labelled gluten free if you avoid gluten.

recipes.title: Lentil and mushroom bolognese
recipes.summary: A rich, plant-based bolognese that freezes really well.

ingredients.name: vegetable stock cube
ingredients.display: 1 vegetable stock cube, made up to 300 ml

method_steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion, carrot and mushrooms for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, herbs and tomato purée and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock. Simmer for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Cook the spaghetti following the packet instructions and serve with the sauce.
check_label_notes: Many stock cubes contain celery; some contain gluten or milk. Check the label.

recipes.title: Chicken fajita traybake
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken and peppers roasted on one tray, wrapped up at the table.
method_steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Toss the chicken, peppers and onions with the oil, spices and juice of half the lime on a large tray.
Roast for 20 to 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Warm the wraps and serve everything at the table with the yoghurt, avocado and remaining lime.
check_label_notes: Check the label: some wraps contain milk or soya.

recipes.title: Pesto cod with roasted veg and quinoa
recipes.summary: Flaky cod with a pesto crust, roasted courgette and tomatoes.
method_steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the courgette and tomatoes with the oil on a tray and roast for 8 minutes.
Add the cod, spread with the pesto and roast for 10 to 12 minutes until it flakes easily.
Meanwhile, cook the quinoa for 12 to 15 minutes and drain.
Serve the cod and vegetables on the quinoa.
check_label_notes: Most green pesto contains cheese and pine nuts; vegan pesto is available.

recipes.title: Crispy tofu and veg noodles
recipes.summary: Golden tofu with noodles in a sticky soy and ginger sauce.

ingredients.name: spring onions
ingredients.nutrition_lookup: Spring onions, bulbs and tops, raw

method_steps: Cook the noodles following the packet instructions and drain.
Heat the olive oil in a wok and fry the tofu for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until golden. Lift out.
Stir-fry the broccoli and carrot for 3 minutes with a splash of water.
Add the garlic, ginger, soy sauce, maple syrup and sesame oil, then the noodles and tofu. Toss well and top with spring onions.
check_label_notes: Use tamari labelled gluten free if you avoid gluten.

recipes.title: Garlic prawn and tomato pasta
recipes.summary: A speedy pasta with juicy prawns and burst tomatoes.
method_steps: Cook the pasta following the packet instructions. Keep a mugful of the cooking water.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan and cook the garlic and chilli for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until they soften.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until pink all the way through.
Toss in the pasta, spinach, lemon juice and a splash of the pasta water.

recipes.title: Turkey meatballs in tomato sauce
recipes.summary: Tender meatballs in a simple tomato sauce. A family favourite.
method_steps: Mix the mince, egg, oats, half the garlic and 1 tsp herbs, and roll into 20 meatballs.
Heat the oil in a large pan and brown the meatballs for 6 to 8 minutes. Lift out.
Soften the onion and remaining garlic in the pan for 5 minutes, then add the passata and remaining herbs.
Return the meatballs and simmer for 15 minutes until cooked through.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the meatballs and cheese.
check_label_notes: Oats contain gluten unless labelled gluten free.
Choose a vegetarian version; traditional Parmesan is not vegetarian.

recipes.title: Black bean and sweet potato tacos
recipes.summary: Roasted sweet potato, smoky beans, feta and lime.
method_steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the sweet potato with the oil and spices and roast for 20 to 25 minutes.
Warm the beans in a pan with a splash of water and the juice of half the lime.
Warm the wraps and fill with the sweet potato, beans, onion, avocado, feta and coriander. Serve with lime wedges.
check_label_notes: Check the label: some wraps contain milk or soya.
Most UK supermarket feta is vegetarian, but check the label.

recipes.title: Spiced yoghurt chicken with pittas
recipes.summary: Tender spiced chicken with a cool cucumber and mint yoghurt.
method_steps: Mix half the yoghurt with the garam masala, garlic and lemon juice. Stir in the chicken and leave for 10 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Thread the chicken, onion and pepper onto skewers.
Grill on a high heat for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Mix the rest of the yoghurt with the cucumber and mint.
Serve with warm pittas and the yoghurt.
check_label_notes: Check the label: some breads contain sesame or milk.

recipes.title: One-pot smoky bean and rice
recipes.summary: Rice, beans and veg all cooked together. Plant-based and great for leftovers.

ingredients.name: vegetable stock cube
ingredients.display: 1 vegetable stock cube, made up to 600 ml

method_steps: Heat the oil in a large lidded pan and soften the onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spices and rice for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, stock and beans. Cover and simmer for 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is tender, stirring once or twice.
Stir in the sweetcorn and lime juice and warm through.
check_label_notes: Many stock cubes contain celery; some contain gluten or milk. Check the label.

recipes.title: Baked feta and white bean pasta
recipes.summary: Roast a block of feta with tomatoes, then stir it through pasta and beans.
method_steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Put the feta in the middle of a baking dish, surround with the tomatoes and garlic, and drizzle with the oil.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the tomatoes burst.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta, adding the beans for the last 2 minutes. Drain.
Mash the feta and tomatoes together, then stir in the pasta, beans, spinach and basil.
check_label_notes: Most UK supermarket feta is vegetarian, but check the label.

recipes.title: Coconut fish curry
recipes.summary: A gentle, fragrant curry with chunks of white fish.
method_steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the fish and simmer gently for 6 to 8 minutes until it flakes. Stir in the spinach.
Cook the rice meanwhile and serve with lime and coriander.
check_label_notes: Some curry powders contain mustard or celery. Check the label.

recipes.title: Turkey cottage pie with sweet potato mash
recipes.summary: Comfort food with a sweet potato topping. Freezes well.

ingredients.name: chicken stock cube
ingredients.display: 1 chicken stock cube, made up to 300 ml

method_steps: Boil the sweet potatoes for 12 to 15 minutes until soft. Drain and mash with the milk.
Meanwhile, heat the oil and brown the mince for 5 minutes. Add the onion, carrot and mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the purée, herbs and stock and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the peas.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Tip the filling into a baking dish and top with the mash.
Bake for 20 minutes until bubbling. Freezes for up to 3 months.
check_label_notes: Many stock cubes contain celery; some contain gluten or milk. Check the label.

recipes.title: Veggie egg fried rice
recipes.summary: Better than a takeaway and ready in 15 minutes, especially with leftover rice.

ingredients.name: brown basmati rice
ingredients.display: 150g brown basmati rice, cooked and cooled

ingredients.name: spring onions
ingredients.nutrition_lookup: Spring onions, bulbs and tops, raw

method_steps: If you don't have leftover rice, cook it, spread it on a tray and let it cool.
Heat the olive oil in a wok and stir-fry the peas, edamame and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the rice and stir-fry until piping hot.
Push to one side, crack in the eggs and scramble, then mix through.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onions.
check_label_notes: Use tamari labelled gluten free if you avoid gluten.

recipes.title: Halloumi and chickpea traybake
recipes.summary: Roasted veg, crispy chickpeas and golden halloumi on one tray.
method_steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the vegetables and chickpeas with the oil and paprika on a large tray.
Roast for 20 minutes.
Lay the halloumi on top and roast for 10 more minutes until golden.
Squeeze over the lemon to serve.
check_label_notes: Most halloumi is vegetarian, but check the label.

recipes.title: Beef burrito bowls
recipes.summary: Spiced beef, rice, beans and all the toppings.
method_steps: Cook the rice following the packet instructions.
Brown the mince in a large non-stick pan for 6 to 8 minutes. Add the spices and beans with a splash of water and cook for 5 minutes.
Mix the tomatoes, avocado and sweetcorn with the lime juice.
Build bowls with rice, beef and beans, the salsa and a spoonful of yoghurt.

recipes.title: Peanut butter energy balls
recipes.summary: No-bake bites for your gym bag. Makes 12.
method_steps: Blitz the dates in a food processor until they form a paste.
Add the oats, peanut butter, cocoa and chia and pulse until it comes together. Add a splash of water if it's dry.
Roll into 12 balls.
Chill for up to a week. A serving is 2 balls.
check_label_notes: Oats contain gluten unless labelled gluten free.
Some dried fruit contains sulphites. Check the label.

recipes.title: Yoghurt and berry pot
recipes.summary: A quick snack that tides you over until dinner.
method_steps: Spoon the yoghurt into a pot or jar.
Top with the berries and seeds.

recipes.title: Smoky roasted chickpeas
recipes.summary: Crunchy, savoury and easy to pack.
method_steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Pat the chickpeas dry with kitchen paper, then toss with the oil, paprika and salt.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, shaking halfway, until crunchy.
Cool completely and keep in an airtight jar for up to 3 days.

recipes.title: Hummus and veg pots
recipes.summary: Crunchy veg with hummus, ready to grab from the fridge.
method_steps: Divide the hummus between two small pots.
Stand the veg sticks in the hummus.
Cover and chill for up to 2 days.
check_label_notes: Hummus contains sesame (tahini).

recipes.title: Apple slices with peanut butter
recipes.summary: Sweet, crunchy and just a little bit salty.
method_steps: Slice the apple.
Serve with the peanut butter for dipping and a pinch of cinnamon.

recipes.title: Banana and blueberry oat muffins
recipes.summary: Soft muffins sweetened with banana. Makes 10.
method_steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Line a muffin tin with 10 cases.
Blitz the oats into a rough flour.
Mix in the banana, eggs, milk, baking powder and cinnamon, then fold in the blueberries.
Divide between the cases and bake for 20 to 22 minutes until golden and springy.
Keep in an airtight box for 3 days, or freeze.
check_label_notes: Oats contain gluten unless labelled gluten free.
Some baking powders contain wheat. Use a gluten-free one if needed.

recipes.title: Chilli and lime edamame
recipes.summary: A savoury, plant-based snack in five minutes.
method_steps: Cook the edamame in boiling water for 3 to 4 minutes and drain.
Toss with the lime juice, chilli flakes and a pinch of salt.

recipes.title: Cottage cheese crispbreads
recipes.summary: A crunchy, savoury snack with a protein boost.
method_steps: Spread the crispbreads with the cottage cheese.
Top with the cucumber, tomatoes and black pepper.
check_label_notes: Check the label: some crispbreads contain sesame or milk.

recipes.title: Gym bag snack box
recipes.summary: Boiled eggs, rice cakes, cheese and tomatoes. Pack it in the morning.
method_steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Pack everything into a lunchbox.
Keep cool and eat the same day.
check_label_notes: Most UK Cheddar is vegetarian, but check the label.

recipes.title: Berry and yoghurt smoothie
recipes.summary: Thick, fruity and filling.
method_steps: Put everything in a blender.
Blend until smooth. Add a splash more milk if it's too thick.
check_label_notes: Oats contain gluten unless labelled gluten free.

recipes.title: Peanut butter banana smoothie
recipes.summary: Like a milkshake, but one that keeps you going.
method_steps: Put everything in a blender.

recipes.title: Green mango smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright, tropical and plant-based. You won't taste the spinach.

ingredients.name: unsweetened soya drink
ingredients.nutrition_lookup: Soya, non-dairy alternative to milk, unsweetened

method_steps: Blend the spinach with the soya drink first until smooth.
Add the rest and blend again.

recipes.title: Chocolate banana smoothie
recipes.summary: Chocolatey, creamy and a nice way to refuel after training.
method_steps: Put everything in a blender.
Blend until completely smooth.
check_label_notes: Some dried fruit contains sulphites. Check the label.
